comments: I'm looking at wriing up the seccomp support for PARISC.

review_comments: I've opted to keep the #ifdef guards but they're trivial to remove. Support for HPPA landed in libseccomp in 2016 but was released in libseccomp 2.4.0 (2019).
We have similar ifdef for `SCMP_ARCH_RISCV64`. So, that's OK. But please add similar `#ifdef` at all places where `SCMP_ARCH_PARISC` or friends are used.
